channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: It seems inevitable that Sam Altman will bring ads to ChatGPT. When will it happen — and what will they look like?
item.description: Everyone believes ads are going to end up in ChatGPT. But we don't know when or how — and it's possible Sam Altman doesn't either.

item.title: A software engineer who landed roles at Amazon, Microsoft, and Salesforce shares his 5 tips for getting hired
item.description: Shubham Malhotra is a software engineer at Amazon with experience at Microsoft and Salesforce. He followed a strategy for all his job applications.

item.title: I got laid off from Meta as a 'low performer' and can't find a job
item.description: Brittney Ball is struggling to find work nine months after her Meta layoff. She's using this time to start her own tech company and go to college.

item.title: IBM CEO says there is 'no way' spending trillions on AI data centers will pay off at today's infrastructure costs
item.description: IBM CEO Arvind Krishna walked through some napkin math on Big Tech's AI data center spending — and raised some doubts on if it'll prove profitable.

item.title: Google engineer said landing an AI role took a year and daily studying
item.description: Maitri Mangal said she took AI courses daily and still spends hours every week learning about new AI-related material.

item.title: A 30-year-old lawyer quit Big Law. Now, she has $2 million to build an AI-first law firm.
item.description: Unlike the legal tech startup Harvey, Soxton isn't selling software to law firms. It offers legal services directly to startups.

item.title: I'm a woman who had a bad experience in a Waymo. I still think it's safer than a human driver.
item.description: Amina Green, a 29-year-old woman, was stuck in a Waymo after two men blocked the robotaxi. She said she'd still prefer Waymo over human drivers.

item.title: Melania Trump was once the one making controversial White House design choices. Now, it's Donald Trump.
item.description: The 2025 White House Christmas decorations reflect Melania Trump's shift to a more low-key role while Donald Trump opts for bold design changes.

item.title: Bernie Sanders and Mamdani joined the Starbucks picket line in Brooklyn — see the photos
item.description: Sen. Bernie Sanders and New York City mayor-elect Zohran Mamdani joined striking Starbucks baristas in Brooklyn on Monday.

item.title: Unjammable drones are leaving wires everywhere, forcing Ukrainian troops to move with caution
item.description: Small drones controlled by fiber-optic cables have turned parts of the battlefield into webs, a Ukrainian special operator told Business Insider.
